title: NWRB cuts Angat Dam water allocation as Philippines braces for strong El Niño

blocks.text: The National Water Resources Board (NWRB) has reduced water allocations from Angat Dam for Metro Manila and irrigation as part of early preparations for a strong El Niño expected to affect the country until the middle of next year.
